tailoring.headline: Product Manager E-Commerce & Web | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Backend developer and techno-functional consultant with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, integrating and supporting e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105/2211) for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong foundation in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, data modeling and agile delivery. Bridges business and IT through requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping, and extensive use of AI tools. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with a proven record in cross-functional stakeholder management.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Manager (m/f/d) - E-Commerce | Web & Mobile
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce expertise delivering robust web and platform solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my techno-functional background to az GmbH Personalberatung. My career combines deep backend engineering in Java and SAP Commerce Cloud with cross-functional stakeholder management, requirements engineering, and agile delivery.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Integrations & APIs
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, managing complex PIM, ERP, and MDM data pipelines across global channels.

bullets.label: Agile Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with product owners, international technical teams, and business units to map processes, plan migrations, and support user acceptance testing.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization & Quality
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and utilized generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, development, and documentation.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can drive value for your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to az GmbH Personalberatung because of your prominent role in connecting top-tier talent with innovative digital and e-commerce environments. My extensive background bridging business requirements and technical execution across enterprise platforms aligns perfectly with your focus on high-impact web and mobile solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional delivery experience to drive successful web and platform initiatives.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms and bridging business requirements with technical execution at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in your Product Manager role at az GmbH Personalberatung. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Manager (m/f/d) - E-Commerce | Web & Mobile - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Manager role at az GmbH Personalberatung. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a strong background in techno-functional delivery, requirements analysis, API integrations, and agile stakeholder management.

I hold a valid German work permit, am currently serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, and can start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
